_not_included.note: Commodities tested but not added to the live scan universe -- either no validated pair was found, or the global benchmark used was found to be the wrong proxy for the Indian equity side.
_not_included.SB=F_sugar: No FDR-significant correlation found for any candidate against global ICE sugar futures. Trend-continuation was uniformly negative even after market-beta correction, likely because Indian sugar equities are driven by domestic policy (FRP/SAP cane pricing, ethanol mandates, export quotas) rather than the global benchmark. Needs a domestic Indian sugar price series (NCDEX/Agmarknet) to retest properly.
_not_included.ALI=F_aluminium: No candidate cleared FDR significance. One trend-continuation number (NATIONALUM.NS) looked attractive but had no correlation backing and rests on ~13-15 non-independent events -- treated as noise, not a validated signal.
_not_included.TIO=F_iron_ore: No candidate cleared FDR significance. Iron ore/steel is more plausibly driven by China demand and domestic capacity cycles than this specific (thinly-traded) Singapore Exchange contract. Needs a China-demand-linked or domestic steel price series to retest properly.
_not_included.NG=F_natural_gas: Tested PETRONET.NS, GAIL.NS, IGL.NS, MGL.NS, and (after research to find a majorly-dependent candidate list) ATGL.NS -- Adani Total Gas. None cleared FDR significance (best: ATGL r=0.20, p_adj=0.85). Trend-continuation is consistently negative across the four pipeline/CGD names at 90d (-0.9% to -7.1% median excess) but not strong enough to validate, and ATGL's own trend-continuation flips sign across horizons (30d -5.5%, 60d -9.4%, 90d +12.9%, on only n=7) -- too inconsistent to trust. Likely explanation: NG=F is Henry Hub, a US domestic benchmark; India's LNG imports actually price off Asian spot (JKM) or oil-linked contracts, which have diverged sharply from Henry Hub at times (esp. since 2022) -- same wrong-benchmark problem as sugar/iron ore. No free JKM data source found. GSPL and Gujarat Gas (GUJGASLTD) were also considered as majorly-dependent candidates but are untestable for a historical backtest: both underwent a composite scheme of amalgamation effective 2026-05-01 (GSPC + old GSPL + GEL merged into Gujarat Gas Ltd, which then demerged its transmission business into a new entity, GSPL Transmission Ltd) -- so both tickers today represent different corporate entities than they did before May 2026, with only ~3 months of post-restructuring trading history. Splicing pre/post-merger prices would repeat the same class of error already fixed for pre-IPO stocks, only worse (different underlying business, not just a listing gap).
_not_included.CPO=F_palm_oil: Tested AWL.NS (Adani Wilmar), PATANJALI.NS (Patanjali Foods/Ruchi Soya), GOKULAGRO.NS (Gokul Refoils), MARICO.NS, and GODREJAGRO.NS against CPO=F (confirmed genuine Malaysian crude palm oil futures, not a proxy issue). None cleared FDR significance (best: AWL.NS r=0.11, p_adj=0.90). GOKULAGRO.NS showed an eye-catching +23.4% median 90d excess return, but with the wrong-sign correlation and only 14 confirmations on a small-cap where idiosyncratic company events can dominate a 90-day window -- treated as noise, same category as the aluminium/NATIONALUM case, not added. Research confirmed the candidate list was close to complete (K.S. Oils, also a major importer, is untradeable -- 1 data point on Yahoo, consistent with known financial distress); Marico and Godrej Agrovet are diversified companies where palm oil is one input among several, diluting any signal. Plausible reason a genuinely import-dependent commodity still shows no signal: India actively adjusts edible oil import duties to smooth domestic price swings, similar in spirit to the sugar/gas administered-pricing problem.
_not_included.candidates_excluded_for_data_quality: RRKABEL.NS (copper) and PREMIERENE.NS / WAAREEENER.NS (silver) initially showed eye-catching trend-continuation numbers (RRKABEL +11.2%, PREMIERENE +39.2% median with a 64% hit rate) because the backtest was substituting each stock's earliest available price as a stand-in entry point for historical trend-confirmation dates that predated their IPO (all three listed within the last 1-3 years). Fixed in correlation_engine.py's trend_continuation_study (skip a confirmation date if the nearest available stock price is >15 days later, rather than using it) -- rerunning after the fix collapsed the numbers to their real values (RRKABEL 90d excess median: 11.2% -> 2.4%; PREMIERENE: +39.2% -> -3.5%), confirming they were artifacts, not signal. Still excluded from validated_pairs.json since even the corrected numbers are weak/negative and rest on very few genuine post-listing confirmations (n=4-6).
